verdict.rationale: Plugging MCP servers in is a client-side capability for AI agents and assistant hosts. The Washington Department of Revenue is a government tax and business-licensing portal (My DOR filing, license applications, rate lookups), not an AI host that could use external tools, so the axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any AI agent or MCP client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
